name: Ananya
summary: Class 12 PCM student in Mysuru, strong in maths and logic, loves building with code. Parents want a stable job close to home.

student.free_text_1: Last year I built a small chatbot in Python that answers my classmates' doubts about physics formulas. I trained it on our textbook notes and kept fixing it whenever it gave a wrong answer. Seeing my friends actually use it before exams made me really happy and proud.
student.free_text_2: In ten years I want to be building AI systems that help people, maybe in healthcare or education. I would like to work with a smart team on hard problems, keep learning new things and lead my own projects. I am okay moving to Bengaluru or Hyderabad for the right job.

parent.free_text: We want Ananya to have a stable job and stay close to home in Mysuru if possible. Engineering in computers seems good, but we worry about private college fees and taking a big loan. We also hear that AI jobs change very fast, so we want something secure for her.

name: Rahul
summary: Second-year B.Com student in Chennai, interested in data analytics, on a tight family budget with no loan.

student.free_text_1: In my first year I made an Excel dashboard for my uncle's small textile shop that tracked daily sales and stock. He started using it every evening to decide what to reorder. I enjoyed finding patterns in the numbers and explaining them to him in simple words.
student.free_text_2: In ten years I see myself working as a data or business analyst in a good company in Chennai, helping managers make decisions with data. I want a steady job that pays well enough to support my family, and I want to keep learning tools like SQL and Python.

parent.free_text: Rahul is our only son and we cannot spend much more on his studies. We want him to finish B.Com and get a safe job in a bank or a company here in Chennai. Computer courses sound costly and uncertain, so we worry about spending money without a clear job at the end.

name: Meera
summary: Class 10 student in Bengaluru who loves drawing and building models. Parents hope she will study medicine.

student.free_text_1: I designed and built a cardboard model of my dream house for a school exhibition, with a rooftop garden and a reading corner full of light. I sketched every room first, then worked out how to make the stairs fit. People kept stopping to ask how I made it.
student.free_text_2: In ten years I want to design spaces or products that make people's lives better, maybe as an architect or a designer. I imagine working in a studio, sketching ideas, building models and seeing my designs become real buildings or things that people use every day.

parent.free_text: We would like Meera to become a doctor because it is a respected and secure profession, and we can afford medical college with a loan. She loves drawing, but we are not sure art or design leads to a stable career. We want her to be happy and also well settled.
